artists.source_line: • A unique format of master classes with the participation of foreign star teachers Starlight.

features.quote: Master classes and parties in 5 directions
features.rationale: The festival offers master classes in several dance styles.

features.quote: styling master classes for all levels
features.rationale: The styling master classes are explicitly aimed at all levels.

features.quote: Everything in one location — dancing, accommodation, relaxation without unnecessary travel.
features.rationale: Dancing and accommodation are described as being in one location, so the parties are in the same venue where dancers stay.

features.quote: Afterparty for guests staying in festival hotels.

features.rationale: A live concert is part of the programme.
Shows are listed among the event's offerings.
Bootcamps are listed as part of the programme.

features.quote: World Bachata Social World Cup qualifying round (amateurs and professionals)
features.rationale: A qualifying round of a world cup is a competition.
The event has several dance rooms, including a separate Kizomba social room and themed halls.
